sweep_note: Screened under time pressure, about 25 minutes, one WebSearch per name. Only HD's baseline was opened, so baseline_history_trustworthy is a default and not an inspection: for foreign private issuers the hunter must check whether the baseline's reaction history comes from 6-K text before using it as an earnings base rate. Short interest was not sourced for any name. Most date confirmations rest on a company press release as relayed by a wire mirror (finviz, PR Newswire, Morningstar/GlobeNewswire); where only a vendor estimate exists, the row says so.
